### nc-review: comments — 1 important, 1 nit

@pcbeingused333 — a few things worth a look, none blocking.

The PR adds the missing `baseURL: config.baseUrl || undefined` to the `createGoogleGenerativeAI` branch of `createJudgeProvider` in `src/lib/judge.ts`, so a `judge.json` with `sdkProvider: "google"` now honours its configured endpoint instead of always hitting Google, plus a regression test that stubs `fetch` and asserts the request URL and a patch changeset. The fix itself is correct and minimal, the test genuinely fails without it, and the change is warranted on its own terms (no linked issue, but an obvious one-line config bug). The one thing worth raising is that the project's own documentation tells users to put Gemini's OpenAI-compatible URL (`.../v1beta/openai`) in `baseUrl`, which was harmless while the value was ignored and now sends the judge to a 404.

**🟠 important · `completeness` · `docs/configuration/judge.md:95`**

The `Supported Providers → Cloud Providers` table lists Google Gemini's base URL as `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai`, which is Gemini's *OpenAI-compatible* endpoint, not the native Gemini API endpoint the `google` SDK provider speaks — the Gemini template writes `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta` (`src/lib/judge-templates.ts:145`).

That mismatch used to be harmless, because `createJudgeProvider` ignored `baseUrl` for the google branch. Now the value is used, so a `judge.json` written to follow this documentation (`sdkProvider: "google"` + `baseUrl: ".../v1beta/openai"`) will request `.../v1beta/openai/models/<model>:generateContent` and get a 404, where before the request went to the native endpoint and worked. The PR body notes this behaviour change, but the shipped docs still recommend the URL that now breaks, and the changeset does not warn existing Google users about it.

Fix: correct the docs row to `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta` (and note that the `/openai` URL is only usable with the OpenAI-compatible provider), and mention in the changeset that a Google config carrying a non-default `baseUrl` now takes effect.

**⚪ nit · `completeness` · `src/lib/judge-templates.ts:121`**

The Gemini template has no `baseUrl` field and hardcodes the Google default, so `nanotune judge configure` cannot produce a config that exercises the new behaviour — the only way to reach a proxy/gateway URL for `sdkProvider: "google"` is to hand-edit `judge.json`. The other templates that allow a custom endpoint (`ollama`, `llama-cpp`, `lmstudio`, `custom`) expose a `baseUrl` field with `urlValidator`.

Not a blocker for this PR (adding a template field is a separate feature), but worth a follow-up: giving the Gemini template a `baseUrl` field defaulting to `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta` would make the fix reachable through the supported flow.

---

<sub>🔴 blocking · 🟠 a reviewer would ask for a change · ⚪ optional</sub>

<sub>Automated code review — correctness, security, design, tests, plus duplicates and scope. A human still decides; this is not a substitute for review and is not exhaustive. The required status checks separately cover lint, formatting, types, unused dependencies, the test suite and the build. This bot never merges. Maintainers can rerun with `/re-review`.</sub>
